docs.title: 关于
docs.text: 本项目基于《周易译注》与黎庭云批注整理，提供卦爻辞的现代翻译与诠释。

docs.title: 乾卦
docs.text: 《乾》 旗杆 (Flagstaff) - 盾牌 (Shield) 元亨，利贞。 大通亨达，利于守持正固。 Great flourishing and free passage. It is favorable to remain upright and steadfast. 参考义项：日出，斗转/斡旋。 《象》曰：天行健，君子以自强不息。 自强：天道刚健运行，这就是乾。君子因此劝勉自己而不慰劳。 Self-Strengthening: The way of heaven moves with firm vigor; this is Qian. Therefore the noble one encourage oneself rather than console oneself. 初九：潜龙，勿用。 空乏：龙潜藏未出，此时不宜施用。 Depletion / Subact: The dragon lies hidden; it is not yet the time to put it to use. 九二：见龙在田，利见大人。 建立：龙已出现在田野之上，利于见大人。 Foundation / Act: The dragon has appeared in the field. It is favorable to see the people in high positions. 九三：君子终日乾乾，夕惕若。厉，无咎。 干求：君子整日勤勉奋发，到了夜晚仍警惕戒惧。虽有危险，终无咎害。 Aspiration / Enact: The noble one labors on vigorously all day and remains watchful into the night. There is danger, yet no blame. 九四：或跃在渊，无咎。 干犯：或可跃起于深渊，没有过错。 Encroachment / Transact: One may leap up from the deep. There is no blame. 九五：飞龙在天，利见大人。 治理：龙飞腾于天，利于见大人。 Governance / Coact: The dragon soars in heaven. It is favorable to see the great person. 上九：亢龙，有悔。 捍卫：倔强的龙，有悔。 Safeguarding / Overact: A stubborn dragon. There is regret. 用九：见群龙无首，吉。 通九 主管：看到群龙而无首领，吉。 All Nine (in Charge): One sees a host of dragons with no leader. This is auspicious.

docs.title: 履卦
docs.text: 《履》 过来 (Come) - 徕：靠近 (Approach) 履虎尾，不咥人，亨。 跟随在虎尾之后，老虎却不咬人，亨通。 Treading behind the tiger's tail, one is not bitten. Prosperity. 参考义项：过来以靠近（徕） 《象》曰：上天下泽，《履》。君子以辩上下，定民志。 扳-扭转：天在上，泽在下，这就是履卦。君子由此辨明上下名分，规定民众的心志。 Reorientation: Heaven is above and the lake below; this is Lü. Thus the noble one distinguishes higher and lower positions and regulates the people's aims. 初九：素履，往，无咎。 来-招徕：预先备具，送致，没有过错。 Attract: To prepare in advance, giving. There is no blame. 九二：履道坦坦，幽人贞吉。 品行：走在平坦宽广的道路上；幽居之人守正则吉。 Conduct: One walks along a level and broad road. For the secluded person, constancy is auspicious. 六三：眇能视，跛能履，履虎尾，咥人，凶。武人为于大君。 执行：一目失明却可以看，跛脚却可以行走；踩到虎尾，咬人，凶。武人有求于大君。 Execution: The one-eyed can see, and the lame can walk; one treads on the tiger's tail, and it bites. Misfortune. A warrior seeks favor from the great ruler. 九四：履虎尾，愬愬，终吉。 担任：靠近虎尾，戒惧警醒，最终吉利。 Assume: Treading by the tiger's tail, one is apprehensive and vigilant. In the end, auspicious. 九五：夬履，贞厉。 来-归服：选择福禄；坚持有危险。 Submission: Choose emolument; persistence brings danger. 上九：视履，考祥其旋，元吉。 踏勘：视察，审察周旋容止，大吉。 Inspection: Inspect the conduct; examine the bearing displayed while turning and moving about. Supreme good fortune.

docs.title: 泰卦
docs.text: 《泰》 泰：安定 (Peace) - 操持 (Manage) 小往大来，吉，亨。 （望祭泰山时）小的往大者靠近，吉祥，亨通。 When sacrificing toward Mount Tai, the small goes to approach the great. Auspicious. Prosperous. 参考义项：望岱；允称。 《象》曰：天地交，泰。后以财成天地之道，辅相天地之宜，以左右民。 主宰：天地相交，这就是泰。君主由此裁度成就天地之道，辅助天地之宜，以此扶助民众。 Dominate: Heaven and earth commune; this is Tai. Thus the sovereign regulates and completes the way of heaven and earth, assists what is fitting to heaven and earth, and thereby supports the people. 初九：拔茅茹以其汇。征吉。 美好：拔起茅草消弭其彙虫。出征吉祥。 Beautiful: Pulling up the thatch to eliminate its swarms of insects. Going forth is auspicious. 九二：包荒，用冯河，不遐。遗朋，亡，得尚于中行。 支持：瓠葫芦大，用来渡河，不要太远；馈赠朋友，失去了，能够帮助正确的事情。 Support: The bottle gourd is large and is used to cross the river; do not go too far. A gift made to a friend is lost, yet one is able to help a right thing. 九三：无平不陂，无往不复。艰贞无咎。勿恤其孚，于食有福。 代-隐息：没有平地不转为倾斜，没有前往而不再返回的。处艰难而守正，无咎。不必忧虑付出，于亏蚀中有福。 Disappear: No level ground fails to become sloping; nothing sent forth fails to return. Remaining steadfast amid hardship brings no blame. Do not worry about what is given; there is blessing amid depletion. 六四：翩翩，不富以其邻，不戒以孚。 奢侈：欣喜自得，不使财富惠及邻里；不要凭借以相合。 Opulence: Delighting in self-satisfaction, one does not extend wealth to the neighbors and; Do not rely on luxury to fit in. 六五：帝乙归妹，以祉元吉。 大-重视：帝乙嫁出妹妹，获得福祉，大吉。 Esteem: Di Yi gives his younger sister in marriage. Blessing is thereby obtained. Supreme good fortune. 上六：城复于隍，勿用师，自邑告，命。贞吝。 骄纵：城墙覆盖城壕，迅速动用军队；从本邑求告，轻慢。固守则有憾惜。 Arrogance: The city wall covers the moat, to swiftly deploy the army; appeal from one's own town, showing contempt. Holding fast brings regret.

docs.title: 否卦
docs.text: 《否》 痞肿 (Lump) - 不：花萼 (Calyx) 否之匪人。不利君子贞。大往小来。 批评的不是（对的）人。不利于君子守持正固。（犯軷仪式）大者往小者靠近。 The criticism is directed at the wrong person. It is unfavorable for the noble one to remain steadfast. In the rite of crossing the road sacrifice, the great draws near the small. 参考义项：错批；犯軷。 《象》曰：天地不交，否。君子以俭德辟难，不可荣以禄。 弭-安定：天地不相交，这就是否。君子由此约束恩惠以避开灾难，不可用俸禄使自己显荣。 Subjugate: Heaven and earth do not commune; this is Pi. Thus the noble one restrains beneficence to avoid calamity and must not seek distinction through emolument. 初六：拔茅茹，以其汇。贞吉，亨。 贪吝：拔起茅草使其聚集。守正吉祥，亨通。 Avarice: Pulling up cogon grass causes it to gather together. Remaining steadfast is auspicious. Prosperous. 六二：包承，小人吉，大人否。亨。 贬斥：囊括欺凌，小人得吉，大人退处于野；亨通。 Denounce: Encompassing acts of bullying brings good fortune to the petty person; the great person withdraws to the countryside. Prosperous. 六三：包羞。 鄙-羞耻：聚集而羞愧。 Shame: Shame of harboring. 九四：有命，无咎，畴离祉。 丕-弘大：获得爵命，没有过错；筹划罗布福祉。 Greatness—Vastness: One receives a noble mandate. No blame. One plans and spreads blessings. 九五：休否，大人吉。其亡其亡，系于苞桑。 尊奉：庇护，大人吉祥。“千万不要，千万不要”，系结在花苞桑叶上。 Veneration: To shelter and protect. Auspicious for the great person. Never, never, tie it to flower buds or mulberry leaves. 上九：倾否，先否后喜。 邪僻：倾斜，先奉行，后嬉笑。 Deviant: Inclined, first obeying, then laughing.

docs.title: 同人卦
docs.text: 《同人》 尊重人 (Respecting People) - 触动人 (Moving People) 同人于野，亨。利涉大川。利君子贞。 在屋檐下随同他人，通达。利于涉过大河，利于君子守持正固。 Following others under the eaves, brings success. It is favorable to cross the great river, and favorable for the noble one to hold fast to what is upright. 参考义项：佣役。随同而不同。 《象》曰：天与火，同人。君子以类族辨物。 戾戾-分明：天与火相与，这就是同人。君子以此遵循族属治理万物。 Distinct: Heaven together with fire forms Tongren. Therefore the noble one governs things according to their clan affiliation. 初九：同人于门，无咎。 威重：在大门通告人，没有过错。 Gravity / Accord: One announces the people at the gate; there is no blame. 六二：同人于宗，吝。 通-交往：在宗族多施仁德（亲仁），会有局促与憾惜。 Intercourse / Concord: One shows many kindness within the clan (kin-centered humaneness), there will be constraint and regret. 九三：伏戎于莽，升其高陵，三岁不兴。 疏通：在草莽中驾驭兵车，要登上高陵，长久不能兴兵。 Dredging / Discordance: One drives war chariots through the overgrowth and seeks to ascend the high ridge, yet for a long time cannot raise the troops. 九四：乘其墉，弗克攻，吉。 慎重：登上对方的城墙，却没能攻占，吉。 Prudence / Record: One climbs the other side's wall yet fails to capture it; this is auspicious. 九五：同人先号咷而后笑，大师克相遇。 统一：会合人，先哭号，后笑；大帅（克敌之后）终得相遇。 Unification / Coordinator: Rendezvous; first cry out and weep, then laugh. Generals can finally meet (after overcoming the enemy). 上九：同人于郊，无悔。 种-培植：在郊外操作锄头，没有悔恨。 Cultivation / Cardiac Transplant: One works the hoe in the outskirts; there is no regret.

docs.title: 大有卦
docs.text: 《大有》 大囿 (Great Enclosure) - 大域 (Great Domain) 元亨。 大为通达。 Great flourishing and free passage. 参考义项：骖乘，强佑以尊崇。 《象》曰：火在天上，大有。君子以遏恶扬善，顺天休命。 休-荫庇：火在天上普照，这就是大有。君子用此抑止恶行，彰扬善行，顺应天道散布诰命。 Shelter: Fire shines above heaven; this is Dayou. Therefore the noble one restrains what is harmful, exalts what is good, follows the way of heaven, and spread edicts. 初九：无交害匪咎。艰则无咎。 友-结交：不要骄傲妒忌；纷争比高，若有限度，则可免咎。 Affiliation / Obtain: Do not be proud or envious; quarrelsome or competitive, if remain limited, then there is no blame. 希腊文图式：philos 英文直译：friend / beloved 九二：大车以载，有攸往，无咎。 占有：用大车来装载，有所前往，没有过错。 Exhortation / Contain: A great wagon is used to bear the load; there is a place to go, and no blame. 九三：公用亨于天子，小人弗克。 侑-劝勉：天子宴请，公侯享用，小人则不能如此。 Exhortation / Sustain: The Son of Heaven hosts the feast, and the lords partake of it; a petty person cannot do so. 九四：匪其彭，无咎。 佑助：防止其偏颇，没有过错。 Assistance / Detain: To prevent its bias, and there is no blame. 六五：厥孚交如，威如，吉。 为-治理：使人信从，激发主动，又有威仪，故而吉祥。 Governance / Maintain: One causes others to trust and follow, stirs their own initiative, and also bears dignity; therefore this is auspicious. 上九：自天祐之，吉，无不利。 宽宥：即使上天都保佑他，吉祥，没有不利。 Clemency / Retain: Help comes even from heaven. Auspicious, with nothing unfavorable.

docs.title: 谦卦
docs.text: 《谦》 咁乳 (Nurture / Suckling) - 嗛：颊囊 (Pouch / Storage) 亨。君子有终。 通达。君子能够成事。 There is free passage. The noble one is able to accomplish undertakings. 参考义项：兼，尽。 《象》曰：地中有山，《谦》。君子以裒多益寡，称物平施。 平-治理：山藏在地中，这就是谦。君子因此聚取多余、补益不足，衡量事物而评价施用。 Settle: A mountain lies within the earth; this is Qian. Accordingly, the noble one gathers from who has too much, adds to who has too little, weighs things, and assesses how they are to be employed. 初六：谦谦君子，用涉大川，吉。 谦卑：小小君子，渡过大河，吉祥。 Humility: A humble and unassuming noble one crosses a great river. Auspicious. 六二：鸣谦，贞吉。 慊-满足：有收成而满足，守正则吉祥。 Contentment: The harvest brings contentment. Perseverance is auspicious. 九三：劳谦君子，有终，吉。 兼-吞并：捞取兼并，君子佑助众人，吉祥。 Integration: Reaping and annexing, the noble one supports the multitude. Auspicious. 六四：无不利，撝谦。 减损：没有不利，指挥谦退。 Reduction: There are no disadvantages. Exercise command to humbly retreat. 六五：不富以其邻，利用侵伐，无不利。 歉意：不相副使其惭愧，适宜征伐，没有不利。 Remorse: Failing to match another causes shame. It is favorable to wage a campaign. Nothing is unfavorable. 上六：鸣谦，利用行师征邑国。 慊恨：慊恨而勉强，适宜出动军队，征讨封邑之国。 Resentment: Pressing on cause of discontent and resentment, it is favorable to mobilize the army and campaign against the domain-state.

docs.title: 豫卦
docs.text: 《豫》 居：治理 (Manage) - 举：攻克 (Occupy) 利建侯行师。 适宜（预先）建立诸侯、出动军队。 It is favorable to establish lords and mobilize the army (in advance). 参考义项：预先。 《象》曰：雷出地奋，《豫》。先王以作乐崇德，殷荐之上帝，以配祖考。 前进：雷迸出而振奋大地，这就是豫。先王因此制作音乐、尊崇德行，隆重进献于上帝，并配祭祖先。 Advance: Thunder bursts forth from the earth and rocks it; this is Yu. Accordingly, the former kings made music to exalt virtue, offered it solemnly to the Supreme Deity, and joined their ancestors in the rite. 初六：鸣豫，凶。 欲望：萌生欲望，凶险。 Desire: Desire begins to arise. Misfortune. 六二：介于石，不终日，贞吉。 与-等待：耿介如磐石，不用一整天，守正则吉祥。 Waiting: Upright and unyielding as a rock, one does not need the whole day. Perseverance in rectitude is auspicious. 六三：盱豫，悔，迟有悔。 预备：仰视而喜悦，晦昧迟钝有悔恨。 Preparation: Looking upward in delight; obscurity and dull delay bring regret. 九四：由豫，大有得；勿疑，朋盍簪。 与-亲附：想要有所成就，需要朋友投契；不要迟疑，朋友联合而亲近。 Affiliation: To accomplish something, you need like-minded friends; don't hesitate, unite with your friends and grow closer. 六五：贞疾，恒不死。 举-纠正：承受非难，有恒心而不死板。 Correction: Endure reproach; remain constant without becoming rigid. 上六：冥豫，成有渝，无咎。 倨傲：瞑目，以安定使人专诚，没有过错。 Arrogance: Closing one's eyes, using peace and stability to make people devoted; there is no blame.

docs.title: 临卦
docs.text: 《临》 面对 (Confrontation) - 临视 (Oversight) 元亨，利贞。至于八月有凶。 大为通达，适宜正固。到了八月会有凶险。 Originally abundant and smooth; favorable to persist in rectitude. Come the eighth month, there will be misfortune. 参考义项：汛期（瀶，山谷水出） 《象》曰：泽上有地，《临》。君子以教思无穷，容保民无疆。 思考：泽上有地，这就是临卦。君子因此竭力服务职守而不穷尽，劳苦安定百姓而不划分疆界。 Consider: Above the marsh is the earth; this is Lin. The noble one, accordingly, exhausts himself in service without end, and labors to settle the people without delimiting borders. 初九：咸临，贞吉。 守卫：函守，贞正则吉祥。 Guard: Contained; persevering brings auspiciousness. 《象》曰："咸临贞吉"，志行正也。 《象》传说："咸临贞吉"，是说志向践行端正。 The Xiang commentary says: "Fully felt approach; persevering brings auspiciousness" means the will moves in rectitude. 九二：咸临，吉，无不利。 碰上/攻伐：共同、减伤，吉祥，没有什么不利。 Encounter: Together, one reducing another; auspicious, nothing is disadvantageous. 《象》曰："咸临吉无不利"，未顺命也。 《象》传说："咸临吉无不利"，是说不顺从命运。 The Xiang commentary says: "Fully felt approach; auspicious, nothing is disadvantageous" means not yet submissive to the command. 六三：甘临，无攸利；既忧之，无咎。 照耀：酣畅，无所利益；既然忧虑它，就没有错咎。 Shine: Being uninhibited, brings no benefit; once one worries about it, there is no blame. 《象》曰："甘临"，位不当也。"既忧之"，"咎"不长也。 《象》传说："甘临"，位置不恰当。"既忧之"，是说咎害不会长久。 The Xiang commentary says: "Greedy approach" means the position is inappropriate. "Once one worries about it" means the "blame" will not endure. 六四：至临，无咎。 给予：给与（以）质询，没有错咎。 Giving/Probing: Questioning; there is no blame. 《象》曰："至临无咎"，位当也。 《象》传说："至临无咎"，位置恰当。 The Xiang commentary says: "Direct approach; there is no blame" means the position is appropriate. 六五：知临，大君之宜，吉。 临摹：记录，大君的适宜，吉祥。 Copying: Recording—appropriate for the great ruler; auspicious. 《象》曰："大君之宜"，行中之谓也。 《象》传说："大君之宜"，是说践行中道。 The Xiang commentary says: "Appropriate for the great ruler" means practicing the Mean. 上六：敦临，吉，无咎。 监理：敦促，吉祥，没有错咎。 Supervision: Urging; auspicious, there is no blame. 《象》曰："敦临"之"吉"，志在内也。 《象》传说："敦临之吉"，是说志向在内。 The Xiang commentary says: The "auspiciousness" of "sincere approach" means the will is directed inward.

docs.title: 坤卦
docs.text: 《坤》 循顺 (Follow/Sexton) - 巡察 (Patrol/Surveyor) 元亨。利牝马之贞。君子有攸往，先迷后得主。利西南得朋，东北丧朋。安贞吉。 大通亨达。利于如牝马那样柔顺而守正。君子有所前往，开始迷失，后来找到主导者(便能得其常道)。往东南西北四方出走（巡狩），得到或失去钱财，安定、安抚（百姓），守正则吉。 Great flourishing and free passage. It is favorable to be gentle and steadfast like a mare. If the noble one has somewhere to go, going first on his own is easy to lose the way; afterward, he can find the master as the constant course. Going east, south, west, or north, he may gain or lose wealth to bring stability and to soothe the people, steadfastness brings good fortune. 参考义项：驯顺，天子巡狩。 《象》曰：地势坤，君子以厚德载物。 载-施行：大地之势柔顺而广厚，这就是坤。君子因此庆赏丰厚，巡察众人。 Implement: The earth's configuration is yielding and broad; this is Kun. Therefore the noble one bestowed generous rewards and inspected the people. 初六：履霜，坚冰至。 谨慎：脚下已踏到霜，就知坚冰将至。 Prudent / Sequel: Treading on frost, one knows that hard ice is on the way. 六二：直、方、大，不习，无不利。 安定：正直方正，光大宏大，领受，无所不利。 Stability / Obsequious: Upright and square, bright and grand; in receiving, nothing is unfavorable. 六三：含章，可贞。或从王事，无成有终。 放纵：容忍显著（恶行），应该匡正。若放纵王的政事，没有成功，只能去死。 Indulgence / Sequence: Tolerating blatant (wrongdoing, which) should be corrected. If the king's affairs are left unchecked and not accomplished, death is the only outcome. 六四：括囊，无咎无誉。 柔顺：包容敛藏，因此无咎亦无誉。 Gentleness / Subsequent: Enclose and store things away; thus there is neither blame nor praise. 六五：黄裳，元吉。 训导：黄色坐裳，故大吉。 Instruction / Consequence: A yellow lower garment (to convey pride and purpose); great auspiciousness. 上六：龙战于野，其血玄黄。 降服：龙在天际战栗，流赤黑、明黄色的血。 Subdue / Exequy: The dragon trembles at the edge of the sky, shedding dark-red and bright-yellow blood. 用六：利永贞。 通六 顺从：利于长久守正。 All Six (Compliance): It is favorable to remain steadfast over the long term.

docs.title: 观卦
docs.text: 《观》 观阙 (Gate Tower) - 台榭 (Terrace-Spectacle) 盥而不荐。有孚颙若。 洗手灌祭而不献上牲牢。肃敬的样子使人信从。 Wash hands for the libation but do not present the sacrificial offerings. Reverent demeanor inspires compliance. 参考义项：灌祭（祼礼） 《象》曰：风行地上，《观》。先王以省方观民设教。 教授：风行在地上，这就是观卦。先王因此省视四方、观察民情，设置考校。 Instruct: The wind moves over the earth; this is Guan. The former kings, accordingly, inspected the regions, observed the people, and established examines. 初六：童观，小人无咎，君子吝。 勤勉：劳作操持，小人没有错咎，君子有鄙吝。 Diligence: Labor and management; for the petty person there is no blame, but for the noble one there is regret. 《象》曰："初六童观"，"小人"道也。 《象》传说："初六劳作操持"，是小人的道。 The Xiang commentary says: "The bottom six, labor and management" is the way of the petty person. 六二：窥观，利女贞。 观察：窥看，利于女子占卜。 Observation: Peeping observation; favorable for a woman's divination. 《象》曰："窥观女贞"，亦可丑也。 《象》传说："窥观女贞"，也是可丑的。 The Xiang commentary says: "Peeping observation; favorable for a woman's divination" can also be shameful. 六三：观我，生进退。 借鉴/鉴戒：观察我，反省进退。 Benchmark / Reflection: Observe myself; reflect on my actions. 《象》曰："观我生进退"，未失道也。 《象》传说："观察我，反省进退"，没有失去正道。 The Xiang commentary says: "Observe myself; reflect on my actions" means not having lost the Way. 六四：观国之光，利用宾于王。 辅助：鼓励国家的宽宏，利于做君王的宾客。 Assistance: Encourage the state's broad-mindedness; favorable to serve as a guest to the king. 《象》曰："观国之光"，尚"宾"也。 《象》传说："鼓励国家的宽宏"，举荐"宾客"。 The Xiang commentary says: "Encourage the state's broad-mindedness" means recommending the "guest." 九五：观我生，君子无咎。 示范：借鉴我，赞许，君子没有错咎。 Exemplarity: Learn from me, approve; for the noble one there is no blame. 《象》曰："观我生"，观民也。 《象》传说："借鉴我"，是说勉励人民。 The Xiang commentary says: "Learn from me" means encouraging the people. 上九：观其生，君子无咎。 劝导：辅助他省悟，君子没有错咎。 Exhortation: Assist him to awaken; for the noble one there is no blame. 《象》曰："观其生"，志未平也。 《象》传说："辅助他省悟"，是说志向尚未平定。 The Xiang commentary says: "Assist him to awaken" means the will is not yet content.

docs.title: 噬嗑卦
docs.text: 《噬嗑》1 誓：谨慎 (Prudent) - 哲：明智 (Wise) 亨。利用狱。 通达。利于决断刑狱。 Accomplishment. It is favorable to use for judicial decisions. 参考义项：折，裁决；裁断狱案 《象》曰：雷电，《噬嗑》。先王以明罚敕法。 饰-显示：雷电，《噬嗑》。先王以严明惩罚诫敕律法。 Manifest: Thunder and lightning combine; this is Shi Ke. The earlier kings used this to enforce strict and impartial penalties, to admonish the laws. 初九：屦校灭趾，无咎。 誓-告诫：戴上脚枷遮住脚趾，没有灾咎。 Warn: Put on the cangue that covers the toes; there is no blame. 六二：噬肤灭鼻，无咎。 折服：吞食柔肉，没过鼻子，没有灾咎。 Convince: Swallow soft flesh, submerging the nose; there is no blame. 六三：噬腊肉遇毒，小吝，无咎。 挫折：吃腊肉遇到毒物，小有吝惜，没有灾咎。 Blunt: Eat cured meat and encounter poison; slight regret, but no blame. 九四：噬干胏，得金矢。利艰，贞吉。 哲-了解：咬带骨的干肉，得到金属箭。利于跟随，守正则得吉祥。 Grasp: Bite into dried meat on the bone and obtain a metal arrow. Favorable to follow; maintaining rectitude brings auspiciousness. 六五：噬干肉，得黄金。贞厉，无咎。 发誓：咬干肉，记录于黄色青铜器。坚持则有危厉，没有灾咎。 Swear: Biting into dried meat, recording on yellow bronze. Perseverance brings danger; there is no blame. 上九：何校灭耳，凶。 界-划分：紧勒着敛尸束带，消除了圈耳（系死结），凶。 Demarcate: Pull the burial shroud ties tightly, eliminating loops (to tie dead knots) ; omen of misfortune.

docs.title: 注疏
docs.text: 1. 噬嗑：颐中有物曰噬嗑。 ↩

docs.title: 贲卦
docs.text: 《贲》1 分辨 (Distinguish) - 扳：挽引 (Pull) 亨。小利有攸往。 通达。小有所往则利。 Accomplishment. Small ventures are favorable. 参考义项：辩论，说事分明以驳正 《象》曰：山下有火，《贲》。君子以明庶政，无敢折狱。 折-摘取：山下有火，这就是贲卦。君子以此估定百姓的征税，不敢誓戒讼狱。 Pluck: Under the mountain there is fire; this is Ben. A wise man uses this to assess various taxes and levies of the common people, and dares not to warn with lawsuits. 初九：贲其趾，舍车而徒。 本-探究：辨认其踪迹，舍弃车舆而徒步。 Examine: Discern their tracks, abandon the carriage and walk on foot. 六二：贲其须。 班赐：颁布需求。 Reward: Promulgate the need. 九三：贲如濡如，永贞吉。 装饰：华美润泽，歌咏，守正则吉。 Adornment: Adorned and lustrous, celebrated; maintaining rectitude brings auspiciousness. 六四：贲如皤如，白马翰如，匪寇，婚媾。 奔-奋勇：斑驳洁白，白马飞驰啊，不是寇盗，是婚媾。 Courage: Mottled yet pure; white horses galloping; not bandits, but a marriage match. 六五：贲于丘园，束帛戔戔。吝，终吉。 征聘：聘问于丘园，束帛微薄。有吝惜，最终吉祥。 Engage: Drop in the hill garden; the bundles of silk are meager. There is regret, but ultimately auspicious. 上九：白贲，无咎。 坟-顺从：白色（土壤）肥沃坟起，没有灾咎。 Docile: White (soil), fertile and raised; there is no blame.

docs.title: 注疏
docs.text: 1. 贲：柔来文刚，刚上文柔。刚柔交错，天文也；文明以止，人文也。观乎天文以察时变，观乎人文以化成天下。明庶政，无敢折狱——刑/民事判罚重于罪，想折而无敢折狱。 ↩

docs.title: 剥卦
docs.text: 《剥》 胞衣 (Afterbirth) - 服马 (Wheel Horse) 不利有攸往。 不利于前往做事。 It is not favorable to go forward with affairs. 参考义项：服丧（仆/朴） 《象》曰：山附于地，《剥》。上以厚下安宅。 亲厚：山贴附在地上，这就是剥卦。居上位的人以此后离开，遏止（军队）分崩离析。 Kinship: The mountain clings to the earth; this is Bo. Therefore, those above use this to bring up the rear during a withdrawal, stopping (the army) from falling apart. 初六：剥床以足蔑，贞凶。 负-依凭：击打床坐来制止轻蔑，这样下去会有凶险。 Reliance / Suppose: Strike the seat to check contempt; if this continues, there will be danger. 六二：剥床以辨蔑，贞凶。 朴实：掊挖底部来辨明污蔑，这样下去会有凶险。 Plainness / Propose: Dig into the base to identify slander; if this continues, there will be danger. 六三：剥之，无咎。 驳-相异：背离它，没有错咎。 Divergence / Compose: Deviate from it; there is no blame. 六四：剥床以肤，凶。 服-承担：依凭于床来仆服，凶险。 Bearing / Depose: Rely on the bed to lie prostrate; this is dangerous. 六五：贯鱼以宫人，宠，无不利。 服御：射中鱼靠宫人，宠劳，没有不利。 Harnessing / Dispose: Shooting fish relies on palace attendants; bestowing favor, brings no disadvantage. 上九：硕果不食，君子得舆，小人剥庐。 保护：大果子还没有被吃掉。君子得到党与，小人持着矛、戟的柄。 Protection / Expose: large fruits are not yet eaten. The noble one can gain favor and support, while the petty hold the handles of spears and halberds.

docs.title: 复卦
docs.text: 《复》 免除 (Remit) - 返回 (Return) 亨。出入无疾，朋来无咎。反复其道，七日来复。利有攸往。 参考义项：丧礼（復/覆） 通达。出入没有疾苦之色，朋友来不高冷疏远；回来恢复其悼念，七天后回来覆盖（棺材，填土）。适合有所前往。 Smooth. No distress when going out and coming in, do not be distant when friends visit. Return and resume their mourning. Seven days later, come back and cover (the coffin, fill the grave). It is favorable to go forward. 希腊文图式：epistrophe 英文直译：return / turning back 《象》曰：雷在地中，《复》。先王以至日闭关，商旅不行，后不省方。 庇护：雷藏在地下，复卦。古代君王因此在冬至时关闭关口，使商旅不出行，君主也不巡察四方。 Shield: Thunder is hidden within the earth; this is Fu. Therefore, on the winter solstice, the former kings closed the passes, merchants and travelers did not go out, and the ruler did not inspect the four directions. 希腊文图式：kleisis 英文直译：closure 初九：不远复，无祗悔，元吉。 恢复：不远就返回，不是举救凋零，大吉。 Recover: If one returns without going far, not to save the withering. Great good fortune. 希腊文图式：metanoeo 英文直译：change one's mind / repent / turn back 六二：休复，吉。 覆庇：荫庇之复，吉祥。 Shelter / Consist: As the protection of shade, auspicious. 希腊文图式：episkiázo (ἐπισκιάζω) 英文直译：overshadow 六三：频复，厉，无咎。 宽宥：以宾客相待之复，虽然有危险，但还不至于有过错。 Leniency: Treating someone as a guest carries danger, yet it does not amount to fault. 希腊文图式：apheimi 英文直译：release / let go / forgive 六四：中行独复。 重复：尽忠巡视审慎审覆。 Iteration / Persist: To inspect diligently and to examine carefully. 希腊文图式：kaleo 英文直译：call / summon 六五：敦复，无悔。 覆盖：覆焘之复，所以没有悔恨。 Cover: As covering over, it brings no regret. 希腊文图式：katakalýpto (κατακαλύπτω) 英文直译：cover up 上六：迷复，凶，有灾眚。用行师，终有大败，以其国君，凶，至于十年不克征。 刚愎：沉迷，结果凶险，又有灾祸。若以此出兵，最终大败，罢黜国君，有凶祸，长期都不能取胜。 Obstinacy: Delusion is ominous and brings calamity. If one sends out troops, there will ultimately be great defeat, deposing the ruler, there will be misfortune, and for a long time there will be no success in campaigns. 希腊文图式：sklerokardia 英文直译：hardness of heart

docs.title: 无妄卦
docs.text: 《无妄》 无虚妄 (Real) - 不迷失 (Steadfast) 元亨，利贞。其匪正有眚，不利有攸往。 大为亨通，利于守正。若不整治，就会有灾眚，不利于有所前往。 Great success; it is favorable to remain steadfast. If things are not set right, calamity will follow; it is not favorable to go anywhere. 参考义项：荒芜 《象》曰：天下雷行，物与，《无妄》。先王以茂对时育万物。 丰茂：雷行天下，万物与之相应，这就是无妄。先王由此勉力配合天时，培育万物。 Flourishing: Thunder moves beneath heaven, and all things respond; this is Wuwang. Thus the former kings diligently accorded with the seasons and nurtured all beings. 初九：无妄，往吉。 亡-外出：不沉迷，前往，吉祥。 Going Out: Free from obsession, go forward; auspicious. 六二：不耕，获；不菑，畬；则，利有攸往。 非分：不耕作而收获，不开荒而得粗耕熟田，奸贼；利于有所前往。 Illegally: Reaping without plowing and gaining a roughly cultivated mature field without first breaking new ground, like a treacherous villain; it is favorable to go forward. 六三：无妄之灾，或系之牛，行人之得，邑人之灾。 亡-扰乱：无法怨望的灾祸：有人拴了一头牛，过路人得到了它，却给邑中人带来损失。 Disruption: A calamity for which no one can be blamed: someone tethers an ox; a passerby gains it, while the people of the settlement suffer the loss. 九四：可贞，无咎。 忘-怠忽：呵斥整肃，没有灾咎。 Negllect: Berate and rectify; there is no blame. 九五：无妄之疾，勿药有喜。 寻常：不终止的病，不要用药，采用酒食。 Ordinary: For an terminal illness, avoid medication and instead use food. 上九：无妄行，有眚，无攸利。 狂乱：不寻常的行动，会有灾眚，无所利。 Unrestrained: Nonordinary act, brings calamity, and nothing will be favorable.

docs.title: 大畜卦
docs.text: 《大畜》 大牲畜 (Livestock) - 需要养育 (Needs Cultivation) 利贞。不家食吉。利涉大川。 利于守正。不家家饲养，吉祥。利于渡过大河。 It is favorable to remain steadfast. Not rearing livestock household by household is auspicious. It is favorable to cross the great river. 参考义项：𤲸，田畜 《象》曰：天在山中，《大畜》。君子以多识前言往行，以畜其德。 职能：天藏在山中，这就是大畜。君子由此广泛记取前人的言论与行事，以蓄养自己的德行。 Function: Heaven is held within the mountain; this is Daxu. Thus the noble one learns widely from the words and deeds of the past in order to cultivate virtue. 初九：有厉，利已。 制止：有危险，利于停止。 Stop: There is danger; it is favorable to stop. 九二：舆说輹。 积蓄：车舆脱落承载之輹木。 Accumulation: The carriage loses its load-bearing crosspiece. 九三：良马逐，利艰贞，日闲舆卫。利有攸往。 勤劳：良马竞逐，利于跟随良善，每日娴熟预备承侍；利于有所前往。 Diligence: Like a fine horse racing, it is beneficial to follow the virtuous, to be skilled (in running) and preparing to serve each day; it is beneficial to go somewhere. 六四：童牛之牿，元吉。 驯服：给小牛装上牿木，大吉。 Domesticated: Fit a young ox with a restraining bar; great good fortune. 六五：豮豕之牙，吉。 怀藏：阉猪的牙，吉祥。 Possessing: The tusks of a castrated boar; auspicious. 上九：何天之衢，亨。 容纳：承荷上天的大道，亨通。 Accommodation: the main thoroughfares that carry the weight of the heavens; success.

docs.title: 习坎卦
docs.text: 《习坎》 练挖坑 (Practice Hole Digging) - 惯囚槛 (Institutionalizing) 有孚维心，亨。行有尚。 有付与，仅（在）中心，通达。行为有常法。 An offering is made only at the center; there is passage. Conduct follows an established pattern. 参考义项：瘗埋/习惯 《象》曰：水洊至，习坎。君子以常德行，习教事。 袭-掩盖：水流相续而至，这就是习坎。君子以此崇尚德行，训练教化之事。 Cover: Water flows on in succession; this is Xi Kan. The noble one therefore reveres virtue and trains in matters of education. 初六：习坎，入于坎窞，凶。 敛-给予：掩盖坑穴，向里面献纳，凶险。 Give / Trouble: Covering a pit and making an offering into it; misfortune. 九二：坎有险，求小得。 滥-涌出：挖坑，有艰难，所寻求小有所得。 Gushing / Traverse: To digg a hole, with difficulty; one gains only a little of what one seeks. 六三：来之坎坎，险且枕，入于坎窞，勿用。 滥-过度：来时咣咣（挖坑），艰难且深陷，落入坎坑深处，不可有所作为。 Excessive / Trench: Came (to dig) with a thud, dangerous and deeply entrenched. Falling into the depths of the pit, one must not act. 六四：樽酒簋贰用缶，纳约自牖，终无咎。 收敛：一樽酒、两簋食，使用瓦器盛装，通过窗户放进绳子。终无过错。 Restraint / Trough: One vessel of wine and two baskets of grain are presented in earthenware, passed in with rope through the window. In the end there is no blame. 九五：坎不盈，祗既平，无咎。 敛藏：瘗坎不盈满，（填埋后的）土坻仅得持平，无过错。 Conceal / Tempering: The sacrificial pit is not filled; the earthen mound after burial is only level. There is no blame. 上六：系用徽纆，寘于丛棘，三岁不得，凶。 聚敛：被绳索捆绑，放置在荆棘丛中，三年不得解脱，凶险。 Amass / Tribulation: Bound with cords and placed among thorns, one cannot escape for three years; misfortune.

docs.title: 离卦
docs.text: 《离》1 黎：黍胶 (Millet Paste) - 罗网 (Clap Net) 利贞。亨。畜牝牛吉。 利于守持正固。通达。畜养母牛，吉祥。 It is favorable to remain steadfast. There is passage. Rearing a cow brings good fortune. 参考义项：燎祭/篱笆 《象》曰：明两作，《离》。大人以继明照于四方。4 照明：光明两次升起，这就是离卦。伟大的人以此缔结盟约昭告四方。（日月互相延续光明，照射四方） Illumination: Brightness rises twice; this is Li. The great person clinches an alliance and proclaims it to the four quarters. (The sun and moon continue each other's radiance, illuminating every direction.) 初九：履错，然敬之，无咎。 罗致：执行追捕，竟然尊敬他，没有灾咎。 Gathering: Execute the pursuit, unexpectedly respect him; there is no blame. 六二：黄离2，元吉。 配对：黄鹂，大吉。 Pairing: The yellow oriole; greatly auspicious. 九三：日昃之离，不鼓缶而歌，则大耋之嗟，凶。 迟疑：太阳西斜时的光，如不击缶而歌，则有大龄老人的叹息，凶。 Hesitating: In the light of the declining sun, if one does not beat the earthen vessel and sing, there will instead be the lament of extreme old age; misfortune. 九四：突如，其来如，焚如，死如，弃如。 求取：如换毛，他们的归服啊，如覆败，如陈尸，如厌弃。 Seeking: Like molting, their submission: overthrowing, exposing (corpses), and discarding. 六五：出涕沱若，戚嗟若，吉。 广布：泪如雨下，忧戚嗟叹，吉祥。 Spreading: Tears pour down in torrents; sorrow and sighing—auspicious. 《象》曰："六五"之"吉"，离王公也。5 六五的吉祥，（是因为）广布王公（以封国）。 The good fortune of the six in the fifth place lies in spreading the princes for the expanse of feudal territories. 上九：王用出征，有嘉折首，获匪其丑3，无咎。 执法：君王用于出征，用嘉礼使人屈从伏罪，法度和原则是手铐，没有灾咎。 Enforce: The king sets out on campaign. Using civil ceremonies to make people submit and confess crimes. The law and principles are handcuffs. There is no blame.

docs.title: 注疏
docs.text:
1. 丽，从丽从鹿。美丽，猛烈，附着，执法，系缚，射中，施加，经过，跨越，匹配，椽柱，光华，高亢，观看，数目。 ↩

  2. 黄离：黄鹂。仓庚，离黄也。——《说文》 ↩

  3. 折首，屈从、伏罪。获丑（俘获敌众）；匪，通"分"，分赐。醜，众也。——《尔雅》 ↩

  4. 继亦系，照为关键字。明与照与日光相关。缔结盟约，昭告四方。 ↩

  5. 区分，以分离时的忧愁描述。昭穆之离。离王公，（以分离）区分之，而照四方。 ↩

docs.title: 夬卦
docs.text: 《夬》 抉择 (Strategic Choice) - 决断 (Definitive Judgment) 扬于王庭，孚号。有厉，告自邑，不利即戎，利有攸往。 举扬（弓箭）于王庭之上，（落点）符合记号。有危厉，从城邑求告，不宜立即动武。利于有所前往。 Raise the bow in the royal court, with the arrow landing on its mark. There was danger, so people came from the city to plead for help. It is not favorable to resort to arms at once; it is favorable to have somewhere to go forward. 参考义项：抉择/决断。校场选拔；开战决断。 《象》曰：泽上于天，《夬》。君子以施禄及下，居德则忌。 弛-舍弃：泽水上越于天，这是夬卦。君子因此散布俸禄给下民，而囤积所得则有所顾忌。 Letting go: The marsh rises above heaven; this is Guai. The noble one extends benefits to those below, but hoarding virtue invites misgivings. 初九：壮于前趾，往不胜，为咎。 缺-废弛：撞到前趾，前往却不能胜任，咎过。 Decrepitude: Hitting the forward toes; going forth without being qualified, brings blame. 《象》曰："不胜"而"往"，"咎"也。 "不胜"而"往"，是"咎"。 "Going forth without being able to prevail" is blame. 九二：惕号莫夜，有戎勿恤。 决-判断：寂静的夜里警惕呼号，有人相助（于兵戎）不要忧虑。 Judgment: Be alert and call out in the quiet night. Someone will come to your aid, do not worry. 《象》曰："有戎勿恤"，得中道也。 "有戎勿恤"，因为得守中道。 "Someone will come to your aid, do not worry," because one holds to the middle way. 九三：壮于頄，有凶。君子夬夬独行，遇雨若濡，有愠无咎。 决裂：颧骨强壮，局限之，凶险。君子刚决独行，遇雨如沾湿，虽有愠怒但无咎过。 Severance: Strong in the cheekbones, to confine them, there is danger. The noble one resolves resolutely and walks alone; encountering rain and becoming drenched, one feels resentment, yet there is no blame. 《象》曰："君子夬夬"，终"无咎"也。 "君子夬夬"，终将"无咎"。 "The noble one resolves resolutely"; ultimately, there is no blame. 九四：臀无肤，其行次且。牵羊悔亡。闻言不信。 果决：臀部无肤，行走艰难，牵羊，悔恨消亡。听责言而不信服。 Resoluteness: The buttocks are without flesh and walking is difficult. Lead the sheep and regret vanishes, yet reproachful words heard are not believed. 《象》曰："其行次且"，位不当也。"闻言不信"，聪不明也。 "其行次且"，位置不当。"闻言不信"，听力好但不明智。 "Walking is difficult" because the position is improper. "Hearing words yet not believing" means one hears but does not understand. 九五：苋陆夬夬，中行，无咎。 决-断绝：细角山羊果决跳跃，衷心离开，无咎过。 Break: Resolutely leaps the slender-horned goat, departing wholeheartedly; there is no blame. 《象》曰："中行无咎"，中未光也。 "中行无咎"，内心尚未广大。 "No blame in the middle path," the mind is not yet broad. 上六：无号，终有凶。 诀别：不要哭嚎，朋友众多，凶险。 Parting: Do not wail, (since you have) many friends, there is misfortune. 《象》曰："无号"之"凶"，终不可长也。 "无号"之"凶"，众人不可长久。 The misfortune of "no wailing" is that the many cannot last forever.

docs.title: 姤卦
docs.text: 《姤》 钩梯 (The Hook Ladder) - 鱼钩 (The Fish Hook) 女壮，勿用取女。 嫁女时装扮她。不可用（花言巧语勾引）来娶妻。 Dress her up for her wedding. Don't use (sweet talk to seduce) to marry her. 参考义项：阿谀嫁娶，巧言令色。诟，花言巧语。 《象》曰：天下有风，《姤》。后以施命诰四方。 求告：天下有风，是姤卦之象。君主以此发布政令，宣告四方。 Petition: Wind moves beneath heaven; this is Gou. The ruler proclaims commands to the four quarters. 初六：系于金柅，贞吉。有攸往，见凶，羸豕孚蹢躅。 邂逅：系于金属辖軎，贞正则吉，有所往。碰见，凶。瘦弱的猪浮躁不安，徘徊跳跃。 Encounter: Tied to a metal axle stopper, steadfastness brings good fortune. If meets, misfortune appears. The lean sow restlessly paces and wavers. 《象》曰："系于金柅"，柔道牵也。 "系于金柅"，柔弱之道受到牵引。 "Tied to a metal axle stopper," the soft way is restrained. 九二：包有鱼，无咎，不利宾。 谋求：用渔取侵占来聚集，无咎错，但不利于招待宾客。 Seeking: To amass through plunder. There is no blame, but it is not suitable for receiving guests. 《象》曰："包有鱼"，义不及"宾"也。 "包有鱼"，按义理不这样给予宾客。 "To amass through plunder," according to moral principles, this is not how guests should be treated (with calculation). 九三：臀无肤，其行次且，厉，无大咎。 遭遇：臀部无肤，行走艰难，有危险，但无大咎过。 Encountering: The buttocks are without flesh and walking is difficult. There is danger, but no great blame. 《象》曰："其行次且"，行未牵也。 "其行次且"，行走未被牵引。 "Walking is difficult"; the movement is not guided. 九四：包无鱼，起凶。 求购：囊括而不统御，征召，凶。 Purchase: To encompass without governing, to conscript,brings misfortune. 《象》曰："无鱼"之"凶"，远民也。 "无鱼"之"凶"，是远离民众的结果。 The misfortune of "not governing" comes from being distant from the people. 九五：以杞包瓜，含章，有陨自天。 讲求：用杞柳包裹瓜果，包容防范，（天坛，即圜丘）设圆界利用天时。 Hold fast: Wrap the melon with willow, inclusive and preventative; set up (the Temple of Heaven, aka the Circular Mound Altar with) a circular boundary to make use of the timing of heaven. 《象》曰："九五含章"，中正也。"有陨自天"，志不舍命也。 "九五含章"，居中守正。"有陨自天"，其志愿不舍弃天命。 "The nine in the fifth place is inclusive and preventative," being centered and correct. "set up a circular boundary to make use of the timing of heaven"; its purpose does not abandon the mandate. 上六：姤其角，吝，无咎。 媾和：谋求角逐，有吝难，但无咎过。 Compromise: Strategically manage the competition, brings difficulty, yet there is no blame. 《象》曰："姤其角"，上穷"吝"也。 "姤其角"，居上而穷困，故生吝难。 "Strategically manage the competition," means being exhausted at the top, hence arises difficulty.

docs.title: 困卦
docs.text: 《困》 閫：郭门 (Outer City Gate) - 閫：宫中道路 (Inner Court Alley) 亨。贞大人吉，无咎。有言不信。 通达。守正于大人之道则吉，无咎。虽有盟约（以约束），却难以取信。 Passage. Constancy in the way of the great person brings good fortune and no blame. Though there are pledges (to bind each other), they are hard to make trusted. 参考义项：围城：从因被困而得不到，到因得到而被困。要盟（城下之盟）。 《象》曰：泽无水，《困》。君子以致命遂志。 实-结果：泽中无水，这是困卦。君子因此招致盟友，完成其志。 Result: The marsh has no water; this is Kun. The noble one therefore summons allies and carries through the will. 初六：臀困于株木，入于幽谷，三岁不觌。 阻碍：臀部被刑杖敲打，进入幽暗山谷，三年不得见。 Block: The buttocks are beaten by a punishment rod; one enters a dark valley and is not seen for three years. 《象》曰：“入于幽谷”，幽不明也。 “入于幽谷”，是因为幽暗而不明。 "Entering a dark valley" means being shut in obscurity, without light. 九二：困于酒食，朱绂方来。利用享祀。征凶，无咎。 困难：匮乏酒食，高贵的朱绂正赐予。利于举行享祀。出征则凶，但无咎。 Difficulty: Wine and food are lacking; the noble with vermilion knee-cover is just bestowing. It is suitable to make offerings (to the people). To go on campaign is misfortune, yet there is no blame. 《象》曰：“困于酒食”，中有庆也。 “困于酒食”，是因为中位有可庆之事。 "Lacking wine and food" means there is celebration within the center. 六三：困于石，据于蒺藜，入于其宫，不见其妻，凶。 围困：被石头阻碍，抓着蒺藜。进入自己的宫室，却不见其妻，凶。 Siege: Blocked by stone, grabbing onto thorny caltrops. One enters one's own dwelling but does not see his wife. Misfortune. 《象》曰：“据于蒺藜”，乘刚也。“入于其宫，不见其妻”，不祥也。 “据于蒺藜”，是柔乘刚而失当。“入于其宫，不见其妻”，是不祥。 "Grabbing onto caltrops" means the soft rides upon the firm and is out of place. "Entering the dwelling and not seeing the wife" is inauspicious. 九四：来，徐徐困于金车，吝，有终。 疲惫：归来，在兵车之中安睡，有吝难，朋友众多。 Exhausted: Coming back, sound asleep within the war chariot. There is regretful difficulty, yet many friends are present. 《象》曰：“来徐徐”，志在下也。虽不当位，有与也。 “来徐徐”，是志向在下。虽位置不当，仍有所应与。 "Coming slowly" means the intent is below. Though the position is not proper, there is still someone to join with. 九五：臲卼，困于赤绂，乃徐有说，利用祭祀。 困窘：处于不安危殆之中，又被赤绂礼服捆缚。随后渐渐有所解脱，利于祭祀。 Distress: Unsteady and precarious, bound by the red knee-cover as ritual dress. Then slowly there is release. It is suitable to make sacrifices (to the god). 《象》曰：“臲”，志未得也。“乃徐有说”，以中直也。“利用祭祀”，受福也。 “臲”，是志尚未得伸。“乃徐有说”，是因为中正而直。“利用祭祀”，是受福。 "Precarious" means the will has not yet been fulfilled. "Then slowly there is release" is due to central uprightness. "Useful to make sacrifices" means receiving blessing. 上六：困于葛藟，于臲卼，曰动悔有悔，征吉。 穷尽：（棺材）用葛藤捆着，与割鼻断足比较，于是触动愚昧，有悔意，出征有吉。 Exhaustion: (The coffin) Bound with kudzu vines, set against the choice of nose-cutting and foot-cutting, thereupon ignorance is stirred; there is remorse, going on campaign brings good fortune. 《象》曰：“困于葛藟”，未当也。“动悔有悔”，吉行也。 “困于葛藟”，是尚未得当。“动悔有悔”，是吉祥的行动。 "Constrained by tangled vines" means things are not yet fitting. "ignorance is stirred, remorse is present" means the movement is auspicious.

docs.title: 井卦
docs.text: 《井》 旁侧 (Sideways) - 傍：靠近 (Drawing Near) 改邑不改井，无丧无得。往来井井。汔至，亦未繘井，羸其瓶，凶。 （旁系）改变城邑而不改祠堂，不用服丧，不受恩德。（彼此）往来驰驱不息。 （靠近）干涸窒塞，整治疏通。未把井绳下到井中，反而毁坏了水瓶，凶。 (Distant Relative) The city is changed, but not the ancestral shrine; not required to observe mourning and do not receive favors. People come and go without cease. (Well Repair) Dryness and obstruction, dredge it. The well rope has not yet been lowered when the water jar is broken—misfortune. 参考义项：旁系/修井；横生枝节，靠近中央。 《象》曰：木上有水，《井》。君子以劳民劝相。 同僚：木上有水，这是井卦。君子因此慰劳百姓，劝导彼此辅助。 Colleagueship: Water above wood; this is Jing. The noble one express his appreciation to the people (in their labor) and urges them to help one another. 初六：井泥不食。旧井无禽。 摒弃：井被泥阻塞，不能饮水。旧陷阱荒废，没有擒获。 Abandonment: The well is blocked by mud and cannot be used for drinking. The old pitfall is abandoned and captures nothing. 《象》曰：“井泥不食”，下也。“旧井无禽”，时舍也。 “井泥不食”，是因处在最下。“旧井无禽”，是时势已舍弃它。 "The muddy well is not drunk from" because it lies below. "The old well has no birds or game" because the times have cast it aside. 九二：井谷射鲋，瓮敝漏。 方-占据：井谷之中弹出蛤蟆，水瓮破敝而漏。 Occupation: In the well hollow, a frog springs out; the earthen jar is worn out and leaks. 《象》曰：“井谷射鲋”，无与也。 “井谷射鲋”，是因为无人相与。 "In the well hollow, a frog springs out" means there is no one to join with. 九三：井渫不食，为我心恻。可用汲，王明并受其福。 彷徨：井已疏通洁净，却仍无人取食，使我心中忧恻。若可用来汲取，王者结盟，则一同受其福。 Wandering: The well has been cleared, yet no one drinks from it; this grieves my heart. If it can be used for drawing water and the king forms an alliance, all will share in its blessing. 《象》曰：“井渫不食”，行“恻”也。求“王明”，“受福”也。 “井渫不食”，所以行而有忧恻。求得“王明”，则能“受福”。 "The cleared well is not drunk from" means one goes on in sorrow. Seeking "the king's alliance" means receiving blessing. 六四：井甃，无咎。 屏-捍蔽：修砌井壁，无咎。 Shielding / Armor: Get the well lined and repaired. No blame. 《象》曰：“井甃无咎”，修井也。 “井甃无咎”，是修治水井。 "Lining the well; no blame" means repairing the well. 九五：井洌寒泉，食。 发放：清冽如寒泉，饮用。 Distributing / Effluence: The well is clear, its cold spring fit for drinking. 《象》曰：“寒泉”之“食”，中正也。 “寒泉”可以饮用，是因为中正。 That the "cold spring" is fit for drinking is due to central correctness. 上六：井收勿幕，有孚元吉。 释放：井纠合绳索，不要遮盖，付与，大吉。 Release: Gathers the rope of the well together and do not cover it. There is trust; great good fortune. 《象》曰：“元吉”在“上”，大成也。 “元吉”在上位，是大成之象。 "Great good fortune" at the top means great completion.

docs.title: 需卦
docs.text: 《需》 糯：黏性 (Viscosity) - 輭：柔软 (Malleability) 有孚，光亨，贞吉。利涉大川。 （儒者）令人信从，光明，亨通；守正则吉。适宜渡过大河。 (Pre-Confucian ritual masters) To make people believe and follow, radiant, and successful; constancy brings good fortune. It is favorable to cross the great river. 参考义项：儒，以道得民 《象》曰：云上于天，《需》。君子以饮食宴乐。 晏-温和：云气升到天上，这就是需卦。君子由此饮食宴乐。 Mildness: Clouds rise above heaven; this is Xu. Thus the noble one dines and feasts. 初九：需于郊，利用恒，无咎。 等待：在远郊滞留，适宜有恒心，没有灾咎。 Waiting: Remain in the distant outskirts. It is favorable to have perseverance; there is no blame. 九二：需于沙，小有言，终吉。 需要：由于沙地缓慢，略有责言，最终吉祥。 Need: The sandy ground causes delay. There is some minor reproach, but in the end there is good fortune. 九三：需于泥，致寇至。 懦弱：由于拘泥而迟疑，招致盗寇到来。 Weakness: Hesitating because of rigid attachment draws raiders near. 六四：需于血，出自穴。 需索：被血液濡湿，从坑穴中脱出。 Demand: Soaked with blood, one emerges from the pit. 九五：需于酒食，贞吉。 濡-润泽：供应酒食；守正则吉。 Moistening: Provide wine and food. Constancy brings good fortune. 上六：入于穴，有不速之客三人来，敬之终吉。 须-任用：进入坑穴，有三位不请自来的客人；敬重他们，最终吉祥。 Appointment: Enter the pit, where three uninvited guests arrive. Treat them with respect, and in the end there is good fortune.

docs.title: 丰卦
docs.text: 《丰》 威风 (Prestige) - 风教 (Moral Influence) 亨。王假之。勿忧，宜日中。 通达。君王凭借它（威风）。疏忽于忧惧（没能点燃烽火），大概如日蚀。 There is passage. The king relies on it (prestige). Neglecting to be mindful of fear (failing to ignite the flames of war) is perhaps like a solar eclipse. 参考义项：烽火。 《象》曰：雷电皆至，丰。君子以折狱致刑。 致-表达：雷与电一齐来到，这就是丰。君子以此决断狱讼，评断刑罚。 Expression: Thunder and lightning arrive together; this is Feng. The noble one uses the judgment of legal cases to assess punishments. 初九：遇其配主。虽旬，无咎，往有尚。1 讽喻：遇到妃子（因来月事）以丹抹面。要依从，没有过错；（如此）以往有佑助。 Allegory: Encountering a concubine applying rouge to her face (to refuse sex due to menstruation). Comply, there is no blame; going forward will receive blessings. 六二：丰其蔀，日中见斗。往得疑疾，有孚发若，吉。 礼-威仪：扩大蔽障，正午却看见北斗。（继续）前往则遭人疑惧嫌怨；使人信从，如同宣告。吉。 Dignity: The screen grows so dense that the Dipper is visible at noon. Going forward brings suspicion, fear, and resentment; to command obedience as if making a declaration. There is good fortune. 九三：丰其沛，日中见沫，折其右肱，无咎。 体察：遮蔽大，正午可见微弱星光；曲折右臂，没有错咎。 Experience and Observe: The obscuring curtain grows dense, and faint stars are visible at noon. The right arm is bent; there is no blame. 九四：丰其蔀，日中见斗，遇其夷主，吉。 礼敬：（仍）在大的蔽障之中，正午看见北斗；但遇到与自己平等相应的主者，因此得吉。 Respect: The screen grows dense, and the Dipper is visible at noon. One meets a lord of equal standing; good fortune. 六五：来章，有庆誉，吉。 礼遇：犒劳彰明，有庆赏，也有声誉，吉。 Courtesy: Reward and distinction are brought forth clearly; there is celebration and renown. Good fortune. 上六：丰其屋，蔀其家，窥其户，阒其无人，三岁不觌，凶。 风-放逸：扩大屋宇，家中却被遮蔽。向门内窥看，寂静得不见一人，三年不复相见，凶。 Dissolute: The house is enlarged, yet the household is screened off. One peers through the doorway and finds a deep stillness with no one there; for three years no one is seen. Misfortune.

docs.text: 1. 《象》曰：“虽旬无咎”，过旬灾也。 ↩

docs.title: 旅卦
docs.text: 《旅》 膂：脊骨 (Backbone) - 札甲 (Lamellar Armour) 小亨。旅贞吉。 小心，通达。（望楼示警以）报告，守持其正则吉。 Careful, there is passage. (The watchtower signaled warnings to) Report, steadfastness brings good fortune. 参考义项：橹，望楼。 《象》曰：山上有火，旅。君子以明慎用刑，而不留狱。 慎-忧惧：山上有火，这就是旅。君子因此力争公正刑罚，不使狱案久拖不决。 Apprehension: There is fire on the mountain; this is Lu. The noble one therefore strives for just punishment,and does not prolong legal cases. 初六：旅琐琐，斯其所，取灾。 鲁钝：细碎地讲述，失去适宜，因此自取其灾。 Reticence: One speaks in a petty and fragmented way, losing what is fitting, and thus brings disaster on oneself. 六二：旅即次，怀其资，得童仆，贞。 奉养：行旅之人就近住下，怀藏资财，又得到童仆可用，征收。 Sustenance: The traveler reaches a lodging, carries his goods, and gains the service of a young attendant. Collection. 九三：旅焚其次，丧其童仆，贞厉。 陈列：奉养，焚烧他的旅舍，（他）又失去童仆；即使守正，也有危险。 Exposure: Sustenance. (Resulting in) burns his lodging and loses his young attendant. Even with steadfastness, there is danger. 九四：旅于处，得其资斧，我心不快。 客处：羁旅而暂处一地，也得到了资财器用，但我心中并不畅快。 Sojourn: One sojourns and temporarily stays in one place, and also obtains goods and tools, yet in my heart there is no gladness. 六五：射雉，一矢亡，终以誉命。 膂力：射中雉鸟，虽失一箭，最终却因称誉轻慢。 Prowess: One shoots a pheasant and loses a single arrow; in the end, one one became dismissive because of the praise. 上九：鸟焚其巢，旅人先笑后号咷。丧牛于易，凶。 粗鲁：鸟焚其巢，旅人先前欢笑，后来却号啕痛哭；（如）在易地失去牛，凶。 Brutality: A bird burns its nest. The traveler first laughs, then howls and weeps; oxen are lost in the land of Yi. Misfortune.

docs.title: 巽卦
docs.text: 《巽》 願：倾慕 (Aspiration) - 还：罢歇 (Pausation) 巽：小亨。利有攸往，利见大人。 小亨通。利于有所前往，利于进见大人。 Small passage. Favorable for having somewhere to go, favorable for seeing the great man. 参考义项：倾慕/罢歇。愻，谦逊恭顺 《彖》曰：《巽》，说也。刚巽乎中正而志行。柔皆顺乎刚，是以"小亨，利有攸往，利见大人"。 《象》曰：随风，《巽》。君子以申命行事。 身-身体力行：风相随，巽卦之象。君子以之申明名义，兼摄职事。 Enactment: Wind following wind, the image of Xun. The superior man uses it to declare the name and act as a deputy concurrently. 初六：进退，利武人之贞。 派遣：进或退，利于武人的贞正。 Dispatch: Advancing or retreating, favorable for the warrior's correctness. 九二：巽在床下，用史巫纷若，吉，无咎。 卑顺：孙子放置在床，仆倒，任用各种各样的卜史、巫师，吉，没有咎错. Obedience: Placing the descendant on the bed, falling prostate, employing various diviners and shamans, auspicious, no blame. 九三：频巽，吝。 逊色：宾服，有吝惜。 Inferiority: Submitting, there is stinginess. 六四：悔亡，田获三品。 置办：悔恨消失，田猎获得三样东西。 Procurement: Regret vanishes, hunting yields three kinds of game. 九五：贞吉，悔亡，无不利，无初有终。先庚三日，后庚三日，吉。 恭顺：贞正有吉，悔恨消失，没有不利。没有开始而成就。在更替前后三日（恭顺），吉。 Deference: Correctness brings auspiciousness, regret vanishes, nothing unfavorable. No beginning but achievement. In the three days before and after the change, auspicious. 上九：巽在床下，丧其资斧，贞凶。 逃避：辞让主宰的坐位，离开，耗费钱财，坚持有凶。 Evasion: Declining the master's seat, departing, wasting money, persistence brings misfortune.

docs.title: 兑卦
docs.text: 《兑》 脱离 (Seperation) - 悦服 (Admiration) 兑：亨，利贞。 亨通，利于贞正。 Success, favorable for holding to the proper course. 参考义项：脱离/悦服 《彖》曰：《兑》，说也。刚中而柔外，说以"利贞"，是以顺乎天而应乎人。说以先民，民忘其劳。说以犯难，民忘其死。说之大，民劝矣哉！ 《象》曰：丽泽，《兑》。君子以朋友讲习。 冯-依凭：两泽相连，兑卦。君子以之给朋友分组，比较领受（研讨学习）。 Dependence: Two marshes joined, the image of Dui. The superior man uses it to group friends to compare notes. 初九：和兑，吉。 掺兑：掺和，吉祥。 Intermixture: Blending, auspicious. 九二：孚兑，吉，悔亡。 蜕变：莩甲，吉祥，悔恨消亡。 Metamorphosis: Sprouting, auspicious, regret vanishes. 六三：来兑，凶。 税予：赐予，凶。 Tribute: Bestowing, ominous. 九四：商兑未宁，介疾有喜。 锐气：商量沟通没有止息，凭借急烈强狠则有喜悦。 Venture: Deliberation without rest; relying on urgency and fierceness brings joy. 九五：孚于剥，有厉。 通侻：托付给服马，有危厉。 Unpretentious: Entrusted to the wheel horse, there is danger. 上六：引兑。 述说：陈述或争辩。 Articulation: Statements or Arguments.

docs.title: 涣卦
docs.text: 《涣》 ![[v2-7125f0cf6015e3d9129939537b9ade59~resize_0_q75.png]] 涣涣 (Gush) - 涣衍 (Spread) 亨。王假有庙。利涉大川，利贞。 通达。君王来到宗庙。适合涉过大河，适合守持正固。 Accomplishment. The king comes to the ancestral temple. It is fitting to cross the great river, and fitting to hold fast to what is right. 参考义项：（𡨡）宗庙祭礼。宗庙之中，先进行盛大仪式，再发扬传承精神。 《象》曰：风行水上，《涣》。先王以享于帝，立庙。 祭享：风吹行在水面上，这就是涣卦。古代君王以此祭享上帝，建立宗庙。 Sacrificial Offering: Wind moves across the surface of the water; this is Huan. Earlier kings adopted it to offer sacrifices to the High God and establish ancestral temples. 初六：用拯马壮，吉。 改换：用阉割的马，强壮，吉祥。 Malleability / Reflux: Use a gelded horse, strong and vigorous; auspicious. 九二：涣奔其机1，悔亡。 炳焕：璀璨华美的光明，悔恨消失。 Illuminated / Efflux: Brilliant and splendid radiance appears, and regret vanishes. 六三：涣其躬，无悔。 畔换：彪炳自身，没有悔恨。 Rampant / Superflux: One makes oneself illuminated, and there is no regret. 六四：涣其群，元吉。涣有丘，匪夷所思。 发散：种类鲜明，大吉。田垄离散，这不是平常人容易想到的。 Dispersion / Difflux: Distinct group; greatly auspicious. The field ridges scatter; this is not something ordinary people would readily think of. 九五：涣汗其大号，涣王居2，无咎。 呼唤：重要的号令涣畔猛悍，彪炳王的治理，没有过错。 Calling / Afflux: An important proclamation spreading rampantly like floods and fiercely like droughts, it illuminates the king's governance; there is no blame. 上九：涣其血，去逖出，无咎。 涣泮：发散他的血，使忧惧离去而脱出，没有过错。 Dissolution / Transflux: Disperse his blood, let dread depart and withdraw, and so break free; there is no blame.

docs.text:
1. 倒装句，机涣奔，机通几，是明的异体字；涣通焕，奔通贲，表示华美 ↩

docs.title: 讼卦
docs.text: 《讼》 容：佩刀 (The Sidearm) - 榕树 (Banyan Tree) 有孚，窒，惕，中吉，终凶。利见大人。不利涉大川。 （防箭蔽障）有帮助，遏制了（箭矢），（仍需）警惕；适可而止则吉，最终则凶。适宜求见大人，不适宜渡过大河。 The arrow shield helps by stopping the arrows, yet vigilance is still required. Stopping at the appropriate point brings good fortune, but the end brings misfortune. It is favorable to see the great person, but not favorable to cross the great river. 参考义项：容，射礼唱获者防箭蔽障 《象》曰：天与水违行，《讼》。君子以作事谋始。 作-改变：天向上运行，水向下流动，彼此背离，这就是讼卦。君子用去除事情谋划开始。 Change: Heaven moves upward while water flows downward; their courses diverge. This is Song. Thus the noble one plans a beginning by removing the affair. 初六：不永所事，小有言，终吉。 争讼：若从事不延长，虽略有责言，最终吉祥。 Contention: Do not prolong if engaged in; though there may be reproach, in the end there is good fortune. 九二：不克讼，归而逋其邑人三百户，无眚。 责备：不能自容，自首而逃离封邑的三百户，没有灾祸。 Reproof: Unable to tolerate oneself, one turns oneself in and flees from the three hundred households of the fief. There is no calamity. 六三：食旧德，贞厉，终吉。或从王事，无成。 申冤：背弃旧有的行为，坚持有危险，最终吉祥；如果随从君王职事，不定罪。 Vindication: Abandon the former conduct. Persistence brings danger, but in the end there is good fortune. If one follows the king in official service, there is no conviction. 九四：不克讼，复即命渝，安，贞吉。 容留：不能公正无私，宽宥（违法）就食，采用变通，(妥善)安置；守正则吉。 Asylum: Unable to act with justice and impartiality, granting leniency for (illegally) getting meals, and adopting alternative methods, proper resettlement. Constancy brings good fortune. 九五：讼元吉。 宽容：共同，大吉。 Tolerance: Commonality. Supreme good fortune. 上九：或锡之鞶带，终朝三褫之。 使用：有时赐予大带，却在一日之内三次被夺去。 Appurtenance: At times, one is granted a ceremonial belt, yet within a single day it is taken away three times.

docs.title: 节卦
docs.text: 《节》 竹节 (Bamboo-Node) - 符节 (Tally / Credential) 亨。苦节，不可贞。 通达。病痛结节，就不可以守为常道。 Success. A painful knotting sickness cannot be kept as a constant norm. 参考义项：疖子（小疮）。节不是一味收紧，而是立界、分流、适度。 《象》曰：泽上有水，《节》。君子以制数度，议德行。 节制、适宜：泽上蓄水，这就是节卦。君子因此制定数目度量，审议德行的边界。 Regulation and Fitness: Water stands stored above the marsh; this is Jie. Therefore the noble one sets numerical measures and deliberates the boundaries of conduct. 初九：不出户庭，无咎。 节度：不走出户庭，没有过错。 Regulation / Stricture: Do not go out of the household court; there is no blame. 九二：不出门庭，凶。 分明：不走出门庭，就有凶险。 Demarcation / Restrict: If one does not go out of the gate-court, there is danger. 六三：不节若，则嗟若，无咎。 管束：若不能适度，就会因此嗟叹。还不至于有咎。 Restraint / Constrict: If one cannot keep moderation, one will sigh in lament; it still does not amount to blame. 六四：安节，亨。 适度：安适之节，所以通达。 Moderation / Strictness: Ease within due measure, and therefore there is success. 九五：甘节，吉，往有尚。 证验：甘美而合宜的节，吉祥；前往会受到推重。 Verification / Instrict: Sweet and fitting due measure is auspicious; going forward will bring honor. 上六：苦节，贞凶。悔亡。 操守：竭力的自我压迫，固守下去就有凶险；但悔恨可亡。 Integrity / Overstrict: Strenuous self-oppression, persisting in it brings danger; yet regret can disappear.

docs.title: 中孚卦
docs.text: 《中孚》 衷心姇悦 (Heartfelt Felicity) - 适合发孚 (Aptly Germinating) 豚鱼吉，利涉大川，利贞。 猪鱼（䱐，江豚）吉祥。（衷心姇悦）利于渡涉大川。（适合发孚）利于保持。 Porcine fish (river dolphin) are auspicious. Favorable to cross great rivers (Heartfelt Felicity); favorable to maintain (Aptly Germinating). 参考义项：孕育，妊娠、哺乳；䱐，江豚；脬，膀胱 《象》曰：泽上有木，《中孚》。君子以议狱缓死。 名义的：泽上有木，这就是中孚卦。君子因此审议狱案，宽缓死刑。 Virtual: Wood above the marsh; this is Zhongfu. The superior man deliberates on legal cases and postpones executions. 初九：虞吉，有它不燕。 孵化：准备，吉祥。宽宥蜿蜒蛇行，而勿燕安逸乐。 Incubation: Preparation, auspicious. Condoning the slithering path, yet never settling for idle ease. 九二：鸣鹤在阴，其子和之。我有好爵，吾与尔靡之。 信任：鹤在隐蔽处鸣叫，其配偶与之应和。我有美酒，与你共饮。 Trust: A crane calls in hiding; its spouse responds. I have fine wine; I will drink with you. 六三：得敌，或鼓或罢，或泣或歌。 俘虏：获得敌人，有的击鼓，有的停歇；有的哭泣，有的歌唱。 Captivity: Capture the enemy; some drum, some stop; some weep, some sing. 六四：月几望，马匹亡。 付与：月亮已经望祭，丧失马匹。 Bestowal: The moon sacrifice is complete; the horses are lost. 九五：有孚挛如，无咎。 信用：使信从，如系联，没有过错。 Trustworthiness: To make people believe and follow, as if linked; no blame. 上九：翰音登于天，贞凶。 浮躁：鸡叫升于天，固守下去有凶险。 Levity: The chicken's crow ascends to heaven; perseverance brings misfortune.

docs.title: 小过卦
docs.text: 《小过》 短暂过往 (Fleeting Past) - 稍微超过 (Slightly Overshoot) 亨，利貞，可小事，不可大事。飛鳥遺之音，不宜上宜下，大吉。 通达，利于坚守。可以小办，不可大操大办。飞鸟留下的声音，不宜变大，宜于降低，将要吉祭。 Smooth and favorable to perseverance. Small matters may be be small-scale, not extravagant. The flying bird leaves its sound; it is not favorable to become large, but favorable to diminish. There will be ritual of Ji (Resumption of normal life from funeral). 参考义项：大祥（葬礼两年后恢复正常生活，饭食中可用调味品） 《彖》曰：小過，小者過而亨也。過以利貞，與時行也。柔得中，是以小事吉也。剛失位而不中，是以不可大事也。有飛鳥之象焉，有飛鳥遺之音，不宜上宜下，大吉；上逆而下順也。 《象》曰：山上有雷，小過；君子以行過乎恭，喪過乎哀，用過乎儉。 庸-更替：雷在山上，小过卦。君子因此行事过于恭敬，丧事过于哀痛，用度过于节俭。 Alternation: Thunder on the mountain constitutes Small Excess. The superior person, therefore, is more than respectful in conduct, more than grieving in mourning, and more than economical in expenditure. 初六：飛鳥以凶。 受祸：飞蝗成灾，有凶。 Receiving misfortune: Excessive locust swarms; there is danger. 六二：過其祖，遇其妣；不及其君，遇其臣；無咎。 前往：拜访祖父，遇见祖母；未达君王处，遇见臣子；没有过错。 Proceeding: Visiting one's grandfather and meeting one's grandmother; failing to reach the ruler but meeting the minister; there is no blame. 九三：弗過防之，從或戕之，凶。 责备：没有犯错就预防，若放纵可能伤害他，凶。 Reproach: One guards against fault before any error has occurred; if indulges, one may instead harm him; there is danger. 九四：無咎，弗過遇之。往厲必戒，勿用永貞。 过失：没有错咎，不责备而礼遇他。过往的危厉必须警惕，不要长期固守。 Fault: There is no blame; one is not reproached but instead received with courtesy. The danger of the past must be kept in mind. Do not persist indefinitely. 六五：密云不雨，自我西郊，公弋取彼在穴。 经过：浓云密布却未降雨，从我西郊而来。王公射猎，在深穴中射取它（飞鸟）。 Passing by: Dense clouds form but no rain falls, coming from my western suburbs. The duke shoots and takes it (the bird) from deep cavity. 上六：弗遇過之，飛鳥離之，凶，是謂災眚。 作祸：未能求得而经过它，用网罗捕捉飞鸟，凶，这叫灾难罪过。 Creating calamity: Failing to meet, simply passed by—choosing instead to capture a flying bird with a net; there is danger. This is called disaster caused by fault.

docs.title: 既济卦
docs.text: 《既济》 既䍤-过滤 (Already Filtered) - 确定成功 (Ensured Success) 既济：亨。小利贞。初吉终乱。 既济：亨通，小心，宜于守正。在吉日朔日（斋戒），终将治理。 all proceeds. Careful, persistence is favorable. (Fasting) on the auspicious new moon, eventually bringing order. 参考义项：斋戒。 《象》曰：水在火上，《既济》。君子以思患而豫防之。 方正：水在火上，既济。君子由此伺察隐患并预先防堵。 Upright: Water rests upon fire; this is Settlement. The superior person, contemplating this, watches for potential calamities and guards against them in advance. 初九：曳其轮，濡其尾，无咎。 酌量：牵拉车牙，煣屈边缘，没有错咎。 Tempering: Pull the wheel rim, bend the edge (with fire); no blame. 六二：妇丧其茀，勿逐，七日得。 听凭：妇人失去了车上的帷障，不必追赶，七日后自然会得回。 Permit: The woman loses her carriage curtain; do not pursue it—within seven days it will be restored. 九三：高宗伐鬼方，三年克之，小人勿用。 渡过：高宗征伐鬼方，三年才战胜，小人不可用此。 Overcome: King Wuding attacked the Ghost Regions; three years were required to conquer them. Petty persons should not employ this. 六四：有衣袽，终日戒。 忧愁：寒衣有破旧的衣絮，整日警戒。 Anxiety: Winter garments have worn-out cloth rags; vigilant all day. 九五：东邻杀牛，不如西邻之禴祭，实受其福。 斋-庄敬：东邻杀牛（盛祭），不如西邻的（简约）禴祭，最终受福。 Solemnity: The eastern neighbor slaughters an ox (grand sacrifice), yet it is not as good as the western neighbor's (simple) spring offering, which finally receives blessing. 上六：濡其首，厉。 排挤：濡滞其蹈履，危险。 Ostracizing: Clog their tread; danger.

docs.title: 未济卦
docs.text:
《未济》 未霽-阴郁 (Murkiness) - 不停 (Persistence) 未济，亨。小狐汔济，濡其尾，无攸利。 未济，亨通。小狐勉强渡河（从漩涡生还），（吓得）尿到尾巴：不适宜做事 When matters are unsettled, all proceeds. The little fox barely crossed the river (surviving the whirlpool), and (frightened) peed on its tail: unsuitable for doing anything. 参考义项：齐，通“ 臍 “，漩涡 《象》曰：火在水上，《未济》。君子以慎辨物居方。 改变：火在水上，未济。君子由此谨慎备办事物，攻克妨碍。 Change: Fire rests above water; this is Unsettled. The superior person, contemplating this, carefully prepares affairs and overcomes obstacles. 初六：濡其尾3，吝。 利用：烹煮尾巴，吝惜。 Exploitation: Boil the tail; Stingy. 九二：曳其轮4，贞吉。 整治：（弓檠）拴缚它的轮廓，守正则吉。 Rectification: (The bow's lintel) binds its outline, persistence brings good fortune. 六三：未济，征凶，利涉大川。 齐备充足：未成功，出征有凶，但利于涉越大川。 Redundancy: Unsettled, to advance brings misfortune, yet it is favorable to cross great rivers. 九四：贞吉，悔亡。震用伐鬼方5，三年有赏于大国。 跻-登上到达：守正则吉，悔恨消失。整治，征伐鬼方，三年超过大国。 Ascension: Persistence brings good fortune, regret vanishes. Reorganizing, to attack the Ghost Regions; surpassing the great state in three years. 六五：贞吉，无悔。君子之光，有孚，吉。6 救济：守正则吉，没有悔恨。君子的宽广，使人信服，吉。 Redemption: Persistence brings good fortune, no regret. The superior person's breadth inspires trust; auspicious. 上九：有孚于饮酒，无咎。濡其首，有孚失是。7 增益：饮酒有帮助，没有灾咎。（但若）沾湿头发，增加（则）轻忽职守。 Augmentation: Drinking alcohol can be helpful; it will not bring misfortune. However, if one's hair gets wet, to drink more will lead to neglect of one's duties.

  1. 尿到尾巴 狐狸受到惊吓或过度紧张时确实会尿到自己身上。这与犬科动物及猫科动物的“应激性尿失禁”类似，是因为恐惧激活了植物神经系统，导致膀胱括约肌不受控制地放松而排尿。 1, 2, 3 以下是关于狐狸与尿液的几个具体细节： - 尾巴构造：狐狸的尾巴非常粗大且敏感，上面分布着气味腺。 - 尿在尾巴上的机制：在极度害怕的情况下，狐狸会缩起尾巴或试图将身体蜷缩起来隐藏，这使得它们排出的尿液极易直接淋湿自己蓬松的尾巴。 ↩

  2. 妨碍，对应既济之方正， （雪桃）丘以为妨义，故不敢以先于宗庙之盛也。 ↩

  3. 同“ 胹 ”。謂以汁調和烹煮。 《禮記•少儀》： “羞濡魚者進尾；冬右腴， 夏右鰭；祭膴。” ↩

  4. 紲其轮，（弓檠）拴缚轮廓 曳通紲 1. 拴；縛。 《楚辭•離騷》： “朝吾將濟於 白水 兮， 登 閬風 而紲馬。” 2. 即竹製的弓檠。 弓卸去弦後縛在弓裡以防損傷的用具。 ![[Pasted image 20260523194339.png]] 说卦传，坎为弓轮 ↩

  5. 振，整治 ↩

  6. 子的宽广 《詩•魯頌•泮水》： “濟濟多士， 克廣德心。” 孔穎達 疏： “謂心德寬弘， 並無褊躁。” ↩

  7. 有副因饮酒，……，有负，泆甚 孚通副，表辅助 于表原因。《进学解》：“业精于勤，荒于嬉。” 附，用同“ 負 ”。 背棄；違背。 《敦煌曲子詞•望江南七》： “夜久更闌風漸緊， 為奴吹散月邊雲， 照見附心人。” 失通“佚”或“泆”。淫泆，放荡，放纵 [indulge in] 是用同“甚”。極，很。 ↩

docs.title: 师卦
docs.text: 《师》 军队 (Military) - 老师 (Mentor) 贞丈人吉，无咎。 翻译：坚守正道，任用贤明长者，吉利，没有过错。 英文：Maintain uprightness, employ wise elders, auspicious, no blame. 参考义项：军队 / 太师 《象》曰：地中有水，《师》。君子以容民畜众。 相容：大地中藏有水源，这就是师卦。君子用此革新百姓，培养兵众。 Compatibility: Water is stored within the earth; this is Shi. Therefore the noble one adopts this to renovate the people and cultivate the armed multitude. 初六：师出以律，否臧凶。 众多：军队出动要按照纪律，出言否定或赞同都凶险。 Multitude / Informed: When the army goes forth, it must follow strict discipline; speaking to negate or affirm is dangerous. 希腊文图式：eunomia 英文直译：good order / law-abiding 九二：在师中吉，无咎，王三锡命。 率领：拥戴忠厚和善的统帅，没有过错，君王三次赐予诏命。 Leadership / Reformer: Upholding a loyal and kind commander: no blame; the king grants edicts three times. 希腊文图式：typos 英文直译：pattern / example / mark 六三：师或舆尸，凶。 遵循：军队惑乱干预主持，凶险。 Capitulation / Deformation: The army in tumult meddles with the helm; ominous. 希腊文图式：spodas 英文直译：riot / clash 六四：师左次，无咎。 尊崇：将领佐助趋奉，没有过错。 Veneration / Conform: The commander flanked the left, attending with the utmost deference (of a disciple), there is no blame. 希腊文图式：parembole 英文直译：encampment 六五：田有禽，利执言，无咎。长子帅师，弟子舆尸，贞凶。 引导：田野中有擒获（俘虏），利于抓住而进行讯问，没有过错。长子统率军队，弟弟运载神主牌，保持这种状态会有凶险。 Conduct / Uniform: There are captives in the fields; it is favorable to seize and interrogate them, no blame. The eldest son leads the army with true command, the younger brother carries the spirit tablet; if this persists, there will be danger. 希腊文图式：mimesis 英文直译：imitation / emulation 上六：大君有命，开国承家，小人勿用。 表率：大君富有声名，开创拯救国与家，小人不要这样。 Exemplar / Transform: The great ruler is highly prestigious: to found and save states and houses; petty people should not act like this. 希腊文图式：hegemonia 英文直译：leadership / supremacy / command

docs.title: 比卦
docs.text: 《比》 篦顺 (Combing) - 矢栝 (Nocking) 吉。原筮元。永贞无咎。不宁方来，后夫凶。 翻译：吉利。推究占卜，行动情状体，长久守正无过错。（时局）不平静，正在招徕，迟来的有凶险。 英文：Auspicious. Examine the divination, situation aspect of activity, long-lasting uprightness has no blame. In turbulent times, currently inviting; those who come late face grave danger. 参考义项：太卜/朝会 《象》曰：地上有水，《比》。先王以建万国，亲诸侯。 亲近：地面上有水，这就是比卦。先王以此建立万国，更新诸侯。 Endearment: Water is on the earth; this is Bi. Therefore the earlier kings by this established ten thousand states and renewed the feudal lords. 初六：有孚比之，无咎。有孚盈缶，终来有它，吉。 治理：使人信从，聚集他们，没有过错。付出充满陶罐，众人来佑助他，吉利。 Regulation / Fitting: Make people trust and follow, gather them, no blame. Contributions fill the earthenware vessel; the multitude comes to assist him, auspicious. 希腊文图式：pistis 英文直译：faith / trust / confidence 六二：比之自内，贞吉。 效法：比照他们，接纳，坚持则吉利。 Imitation / Profit: Compare with them, and accept, if this persists, auspicious. 希腊文图式：mimetes 英文直译：imitator / follower 六三：比之匪人。 顺从：寄托于不当的人。 Subservience / Unfit: Entrusting oneself to the inappropriate people; this brings harm. 希腊文图式：parasitos 英文直译：hanger-on / toady 六四：外比之，贞吉。 配合：外人辅助他，坚持则吉利。 Alignment / Outfit: Outsiders assist him, if this persists, auspicious. 希腊文图式：symmaches 英文直译：ally / companion 九五：显比，王用三驱，失前禽，邑人不诫，吉。 亲和：和乐亲近，君王用三驱之礼，失掉前来的猎物，邑人不警诫，吉利。 Affinity / Benefit: Harmonious drawing near. The king uses the three-drive ritual, loses the game coming forward, the townspeople are not warned, auspicious. 希腊文图式：philia 英文直译：friendship / love / affection 上六：比之无首，凶。 勾结：无道地配合，凶险。 Collusion / Overfit: Aligning without principle, dangerous. 希腊文图式：sumphonia 英文直译：conspiracy / collusion

docs.title: 小畜卦
docs.text: 《小畜》 小牲畜 (Flock) - 稍蕃息 (Gradual Reproduction) 亨。密云不雨，自我西郊。 亨通。浓云密布，却尚未降雨；云气从西郊而来。 Prosperity. Dense clouds gather, yet no rain falls; they come from our western outskirts. 参考义项：滀，水聚、郁结 《象》曰：风行天上，《小畜》。君子以懿文德。 抑-强迫：风行于天上，这就是小畜。君子以美好来纹饰德行。 Compulsion: Wind moves across heaven; this is Xiao Chu. Thus the noble one adorns conduct with beauty. 初九：复自道，何其咎，吉。 守-奉行：因引导而履行，哪里会有过错？吉利。 Abiding by: Carry out under guidance—how could there be blame? Auspicious. 九二：牵复，吉。 守护：牵引而返回，吉利。 Guarding: Drawn back, it returns. Auspicious. 九三：舆说輹，夫妻反目。 守-请求：车舆脱落了輹木，夫妻彼此反目。 Ask: The carriage loses its axle-brace; husband and wife turn against each other. 六四：有孚，血去，惕出，无咎。 治理：有帮助，血液散去，戒惧解除，没有过错。 Treatment: It helps. The blood drains away and fear is released. There is no blame. 九五：有孚挛如，富以其邻。 孝顺：使人信从，如彼此紧密相连，因其邻里富足。 Filial Devotion: One wins people's trust, as though all were closely bound together, and becomes prosperous through the neighbors. 上九：既雨既处，尚德载。妇贞厉。月几望，君子征凶。 守持：已经降雨已经停，所承恩惠已满载。妇人坚持会有危险；月亮达到十五望月，君子若出征则凶。 Uphold: The rain has fallen and stopped; the favor received is borne to the full. Persistence brings danger for the woman. The moon has reached its fifteenth-day fullness; if the noble one marches forth, misfortune follows.

docs.title: 项目简介 / About the Project
docs.text:
本项目以《周易》为核心，对卦辞、爻辞与《象传》进行现代汉语释义和英语翻译，可视为一块辅助理解《易经》语义系统的“数字罗塞塔石碑”。

本项目围绕各卦卦名，尝试以“卦爻辞作为卦名多义词解释”为基本假设梳理各卦含义、及其体现的关系与变化。译文力求在保留原文结构与关键意象的同时，呈现各爻在卦象发展“太极图”过程中的语义位置，在辞的构成中体现象的魅力。

Centered on the Zhouyi, this project offers modern Chinese interpretations and English translations of the hexagram statements, line statements, and the Commentary on the Images. It may be regarded as a “digital Rosetta Stone” designed to aid understanding of the semantic system of the I Ching.

Organized around the name of each hexagram, this project adopt a working hypothesis: the hexagram and line statements function as glosses on the multiple meanings of that name. On this basis, the project traces the meanings of each hexagram and the relationships and transformations they embody. While preserving the structure and key imagery of the source text, the translations seek to locate each line within the semantic progression represented by the hexagram’s “Taiji diagram.” Therefore, we strive to embody the charm of imagery in the composition of words.

docs.title: 页面结构 / Page Structure
docs.text:
每一卦的译文通常包含以下部分：

中文内容 English description 卦名及核心义象 Hexagram name and its central image or semantic range 卦辞 Original hexagram statement, modern Chinese interpretation, and English translation 《象》传 The Image commentary and its translation 初爻至上爻 Each line statement, with its interpretive label and translation 用九或用六 The special all-nine or all-six statement, where applicable

本站内容仍在持续整理中；术语和译文可能随研究推进而修订。 This is an evolving work. Terminology and translations may be refined as the research develops.
